South Korean internet giant Naver has signed an agreement with global investment firm Brookfield to secure USD 9 billion in AI computing infrastructure, clearing a key condition for Nvidia's planned USD 1 billion equity investment in the company. Under the agreement, an asset company established by Brookfield's AI Infrastructure Fund will develop and manage the infrastructure, including data centres and graphics processing units (GPUs).
